item.title: MIT Flat-to-3D Morphing Structures Draw Attention for Agent-Driven Fabrication
item.summary: MIT CSAIL researchers developed flat structures that morph into complex 3D shapes with a single string pull, presented at SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 and amplified by technology analyst Ronald van Loon on X on August 17, 2026 — a programmable-matter advance with direct implications for agent-driven physical fabrication.
